scenes.headline: How LiveTranslate interprets speech while it is spoken
scenes.sub: A Thinker, a Talker, one interleaved sequence, and how the lag is scored.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Truffle! Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate interprets speech while it's still being spoken. Here's how it's built, and how its lag is measured.

scenes.text: One causal sequence: video, audio, source text and translation, interleaved in time order, so translation never waits on a hand-off between models.
scenes.say: The idea: instead of three models in a row, one causal sequence holds audio, video, source text and translation, interleaved in time. No hand-offs to wait on.

scenes.title: A Thinker writes, a Talker speaks

steps.say: Video and audio stream into the Thinker, a hybrid mixture of experts. It writes source text and translation into the same sequence, in time order.

steps.note: turns bounded by speaker, not silence
steps.say: Turns are now cut by speaker, not by silence. Source and translation come out aligned, each with a speaker label.
The Talker turns the translation into speech, cloning the voice from the live input, so each speaker keeps their own timbre.

scenes.title: How lag is scored
scenes.text: lag = mean over words of (d_i - d*_i)
scenes.say: How is lag scored? As the average gap between two staircases.

parts.note: source audio heard when word i is emitted
parts.say: D i: how much source audio had arrived when word i came out.

parts.note: an oracle interpreter, perfectly in sync
parts.say: D star i: when an oracle, perfectly in sync with the speaker, would say it.

scenes.label: average lag, while xCOMET quality rose 83.0 to 85.7, same 70 directions
scenes.say: The result: average lag fell from two point eight to two point three seconds, and quality rose too, from eighty-three to eighty-five point seven. Usually those two trade.

scenes.label: Supported languages with a published number
scenes.note: every direction has English or Chinese at one end
scenes.say: The catch: that's nineteen of sixty supported languages, all through English or Chinese. And the architecture is disclosed as a diagram and a sentence.

scenes.text: A lag number alone means nothing in interpretation. The result is lag and quality improving together.

recap: One sequence: audio, source text, translation
Turns cut by speaker; voice cloned live
Lag down to 2.3s with quality up
scenes.say: To recap: one interleaved sequence, turns cut by speaker, and less lag without losing quality.
